newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Dec 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Authorities of Jessore jail and local police have filed separate cases against more than 150 prisoners on various charges following the jail-revolt incidents.
The joint commitee to decide the modalities of joint monitoring of the Ganges water flow begins its first meeting in Dhaka on Tuesday.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina announced compensation of 50,000 taka for each of the prisoners killed in Sunday's police operation in Jessore jail.
A mild earthquake shook the northern district town of Rangpur and adjoining areas on Monday.
The cabinet in a meeting on Monday approved the proposal of Agriculture Census 1997.
Four human rights organisations have expressed concern at the death of eight prisoners in Jessore jail during a crackdown to quell a week-long revolt.
Angered by sharp fall in stock prices for the last few days, traders in the kerb market on Monday threatened to stop trading at the DSE floor from Sunday.
Local newsprint is facing stiff competition from higher quality imported papers. Over 3,000 tonnes of newsprint worth 80 million taka are lying unsold with Khulna Newsprint Mills.
